0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the HTS adapter + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an HTS-account diamond — seeds AccessControl, grants `admin` both HTS roles (associations / token creation and treasury operations) and registers the IHTSAdapter interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer). Token associations happen later via `associateToken`, so no external reference is needed at init time.
